initialize(name, symbol, communitySettings_) public initializer that sets up ownable, NFT authorship and community settings
create(URI, commissionParams) mints a token, sets URI and commission settings; guarded by canRecord
getCommission(tokenId) public view returning token and resulting commission amount
claimLostToken(erc20address) onlyOwner sweeping ERC20 balance to the owner
listForSale(tokenId, amount, consumeToken) marks a token for sale, onlyNFTOwner
removeFromSale(tokenId) clears the sale flag, onlyNFTOwner
buy(tokenId) payable nonReentrant purchase with ETH, refunds excess and pays owner via low-level calls
buyWithToken(tokenId) nonReentrant purchase using an ERC20 token via transferFrom/transfer
offerToPayCommission(tokenId, amount) adds/removes an offer to pay a share of the author commission
_getCommission(tokenId) internal view computing decayed commission from timestamps and multipliers
_transfer(from, to, tokenId) override that pays author commission before the base ERC721 transfer
_transferPay(tokenId, addr, commissionToken, amount) private helper pulling ERC20 commission funds via transferFrom
_canRecord(roleName) private view querying the external ICommunity contract for msg.sender roles
transferAuthorship(to, tokenId) lets the current author hand over authorship
authorOf(tokenId) view returning the author of a token
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address
block.timestamp, miner-controllable time used for commission and creation timestamps
Low-level call{value: refund}('') sending ETH back to msg.sender inside buy()
Low-level call{value: amount}('') paying the token owner inside buy()
External IERC20 transfer of the full contract balance in claimLostToken()
External IERC20 transferFrom pulling sale tokens from the buyer in buyWithToken()
External IERC20 transfer paying the owner in buyWithToken()
External IERC20 transfer of the author commission inside _transfer()
External IERC20 transferFrom collecting offered commission in _transferPay()
Repeated mul/div loop recomputing commission in _getCommission()
Unbounded loop over the externally returned roles array in _canRecord() with an external ICommunity call
tokenId parameter used by buy, buyWithToken, listForSale, removeFromSale, commission and transfer functions
amount parameter of listForSale and offerToPayCommission
consumeToken address parameter of listForSale holding the sale ERC20 address
URI parameter of create() stored as the token URI
CommissionParams struct parameter of create() carrying commission configuration
name parameter of initialize() forwarded to __NFTAuthorship_init
symbol parameter of initialize() forwarded to __NFTAuthorship_init
CommunitySettings struct parameter of initialize() assigned to state
erc20address parameter of claimLostToken() used for the sweep transfer
to parameter of transferAuthorship() receiving authorship
funds local in buy() holding msg.value
refund local in buy() holding the excess ETH sent back to the caller
owner local in buy()/buyWithToken() from ownerOf(tokenId) receiving payment
success boolean local capturing the result of external calls in buy()
needToObtain local in buyWithToken() holding the sale price
saleToken IERC20 handle built from the sale erc20Address in buyWithToken()
minAmount local in buyWithToken() and _transferPay() bounding the payable amount
commissionAmountLeft local in _transfer() tracking the remaining author commission
len local in _transfer() holding the number of commission offer addresses
tmpI local in _transfer() snapshot of the remaining commission inside the loop
commissionToken local in _transfer() holding the ERC20 used for author commission
commissionAmount local in _transfer() holding the total commission computed by _getCommission

edges.reason: create() mints to msg.sender and records msg.sender as author, so the caller identity drives ownership and authorship
claimLostToken() is restricted by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender()
buy() uses msg.sender as the refund recipient and as the new token owner
buyWithToken() pulls tokens from and mints to msg.sender
offerToPayCommission() stores offer amounts against msg.sender
_transferPay() pulls offered commission from the offer addresses derived from msg.sender actions
_canRecord() queries the external community contract for the roles of msg.sender
transferAuthorship() requires msg.sender to be the current author
create() records _commissions[tokenId].createdTs from block.timestamp
_getCommission() derives elapsed periods from block.timestamp, making the commission time dependent
the number of loop iterations recomputing commission depends on block.timestamp
the low-level refund call transfers control to msg.sender which can re-enter buy()
the low-level payment to the previous owner can call back into the contract
an arbitrary ERC20 transferFrom can execute callbacks and re-enter the purchase flow
an arbitrary ERC20 transfer to the author can execute callbacks during _transfer
an arbitrary ERC20 transferFrom in _transferPay can execute callbacks during the transfer flow
the external ICommunity.getRoles call inside the canRecord modifier runs before create() mints
getCommission() resolves the commission keyed by the tokenId parameter
listForSale() writes _salesData for the given tokenId
removeFromSale() clears the sale flag for the given tokenId
buy() uses tokenId to look up sale data, existence and owner
buyWithToken() uses tokenId to look up sale data, existence and owner
offerToPayCommission() records offers under the supplied tokenId
_getCommission() reads the commission settings for the given tokenId
_transfer() computes author commission and moves the given tokenId
_transferPay() removes the payed offer for the given tokenId
transferAuthorship() changes the author of the given tokenId
authorOf() reads _authors for the given tokenId
the amount parameter becomes the sale price written to _salesData
consumeToken becomes the sale ERC20 address, zero meaning native coins
URI is stored as the token metadata URI through _setTokenURI
commissionParams fields are copied into _commissions[tokenId]
name is forwarded to the ERC721 initialization inside initialize()
symbol is forwarded to the ERC721 initialization inside initialize()
communitySettings_ is assigned to the communitySettings state variable
erc20address selects the token whose balance is swept in claimLostToken()
to becomes the new author stored in _authors in transferAuthorship()
funds holds msg.value and is compared against the sale amount in buy()
refund is the ETH amount forwarded by the low-level call to msg.sender
owner is the recipient address of the low-level value call in buy()
success captures the boolean result of the external calls in buy()
needToObtain is the amount pulled by saleToken.transferFrom in buyWithToken()
saleToken is the ERC20 handle used for transferFrom in buyWithToken()
saleToken is the ERC20 handle used for the owner transfer in buyWithToken()

commissionAmountLeft bounds how much each offer address is asked to pay
len bounds the loop iterating the offer addresses passed to _transferPay()
tmpI snapshots the remaining commission handed to _transferPay()
commissionToken selects the arbitrary ERC20 transferred to the author
commissionAmount is the ERC20 amount transferred to the author before the ERC721 transfer
create() increments the _tokenIds counter after minting
create() initializes _commissions[tokenId] fields
create() stores the token URI through _setTokenURI into _tokenURIs
listForSale() writes amount, isSale and erc20Address into _salesData
removeFromSale() resets the isSale flag in _salesData
offerToPayCommission() adds/removes offers in _commissions[tokenId]
_getCommission() reads amount, token, multiply, interval and createdTs from _commissions
_transfer() resolves the author from _authors to pay commission
_transfer() iterates _authoredTokens related offer/author sets during commission payout
buy() performs the refund low-level call before transferring the token
buy() pays the owner after the refund low-level call and before clearing sale state
buy() calls the internal transfer which triggers further external ERC20 commission payments
buy() clears the sale only after the external calls complete
the token transfer follows the refund call while state has not been fully updated
the sale flag is removed only after the ETH payment to the previous owner
buyWithToken() calls _transfer which performs external ERC20 transfers
buyWithToken() clears the sale after the ERC20 transfers
in buyWithToken() the owner payment follows the buyer transferFrom
_transfer() loops calling _transferPay for every commission offer address
_transfer() calls _getCommission to compute the amount owed to the author
_transfer() resolves the author via authorOf before paying commission
transferAuthorship() fetches the current author via authorOf for the authorization check
claimLostToken() performs the ERC20 transfer of the contract balance
_canRecord() iterates the roles array returned by the external community call
_getCommission() multiplies and divides the commission in a loop whose iteration count is time derived
create() restricts minting via the canRecord modifier which relies on the external community role lookup

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId is the primary user-controlled key consumed by the purchase entry point
amount is only used to set the sale price in listForSale
consumeToken only selects the sale payment token in listForSale
URI is only consumed when minting metadata in create
commissionParams is only destructured into commission state in create
name is only forwarded to the token initialization
symbol is only forwarded to the token initialization
communitySettings_ only sets the community state in initialize
erc20address only selects the token swept by claimLostToken
to becomes the new author inside transferAuthorship
funds only holds msg.value inside buy
refund is the exact value passed to the refund low-level call
owner is the recipient of the owner payment low-level call
success only captures the boolean results of the external calls in buy
needToObtain is the amount pulled by the transferFrom call in buyWithToken
saleToken is the ERC20 handle used only inside buyWithToken
minAmount bounds the transferFrom amount pulled in _transferPay
commissionAmountLeft only tracks the remaining commission inside _transfer
len only bounds the offer address loop inside _transfer
tmpI is a loop-local snapshot of the remaining commission inside _transfer
commissionToken selects the ERC20 transferred to the author
commissionAmount is the value transferred to the author in _transfer
